name: Kenneth Wayne Yerton
paragraphs: I've served time, been homeless, and felt hopeless. I've lost many people and things because of drugs. Through a good program, a changed mindset, and like-minded people, I've learned that you can find yourself again.

I came to Hope House Guthrie because I was sick of being sick. At 52, I had hit my bottom. Hope House Guthrie has helped me with employment, mental health, stability, family togetherness, and close friendships.

I'm proud to be sober for almost two years and to have become the kitchen manager at Hope House Guthrie. I've kept the same job and phone number, and I'm helping people avoid going down the road I did.

I'm working toward my PRSS certification and a kitchen management certificate. I want supporters to know that the help here goes to people. It's real-time work that supports so many things in our community.
quote: Through a good program, a changed mindset, and like-minded people, you can find yourself again.
